newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat says ASC rejects GPG change.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat says ASC rejects GPG change.

text.p: Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said on Friday it had been told by the Australian Securities Commission that the application by Guiness Peat Group Plc to make a full bid for the tourism and leisure group had been unsuccessful.
"Ballarat Brewing was informed yesterday by the ASC that GPG's application was unsuccessful," the company said.
GPG had asked the ASC to alter its bid for the company from a proportional bid of A$2.45 per share to a full bid.

Ballarat Brewing, which has Foster's Brewing Group Ltd as its largest shareholder with a 33 percent holding, said the GPG bid as it now stands had no practical effect and if a full bid was made GPG would have to follow usual practice and prepare a new Part A offer document.
